title: PlanHandoff
description: Frontmatter envelope written by /henkaten-council:from-plan when it persists a plan-mode artifact. The body of the persisted file follows the frontmatter as verbatim plan-mode prose. The envelope is serialised as JSON inside YAML-style '---' fences (JSON is a valid YAML subset) so no YAML dependency is required to parse it. See skills/from-plan/SKILL.md for the routing logic that consumes this envelope and templates/plan-handoff-frontmatter.md for the reference layout.

intent.description: Which lifecycle entry point the plan targets. bootstrap = no .harness/ yet; pre-sprint = harness+council exist and a pending sprint has no contract; course-correction = recent sprint FAIL or an open change_origin:active high-risk henka.

sprint_target.description: Sprint number this plan targets. REQUIRED when intent is pre-sprint or course-correction; null or omitted for bootstrap.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the plan was persisted by scripts/persist-plan.py.

plan_mode_session_id.description: Claude Code session id at the time of plan approval, when the runtime surfaces it. Null or omitted when not available.

plan_sha256.description:
SHA-256 hex digest of the canonicalised plan body. Canonical form: the UTF-8 bytes that follow the closing '---' fence's terminating newline and the single blank-line separator (
), normalised to end with exactly one trailing newline. An external auditor verifies the chain by reading the persisted file, stripping the frontmatter fence (regex `^---
.*?
---

`), and re-hashing the remaining bytes. Cited as evidence in the plan-bridge decision-log entry.

governance_state_at_capture.description: Snapshot of governance-relevant state at the time the plan was persisted. Captured for audit only; downstream skills MUST re-read live state rather than trust this snapshot.

effective_autonomy.description: Effective autonomy floor from .council/state/effective-autonomy.json, or 4 (the orchestrator default) when .council/ does not yet exist (bootstrap case).

open_henka_count.description: Count of henka records in .council/henka-register.jsonl at capture time. 0 when .council/ does not yet exist.
